title: LPG Storage Bullet

introduction.definition: An LPG bullet is a horizontal pressure vessel storing liquefied petroleum gas under its own vapour pressure. It is filled to no more than about 85 % to allow for liquid expansion, and protected by relief valves, water deluge and remote isolation.

classification.type: Horizontal LPG bullet with hemispherical heads

introduction.summary: An LPG bullet is a horizontal pressure vessel that stores liquefied petroleum gas under its own vapour pressure. It is filled to no more than about 85 % so the liquid can expand. Safety relief valves, a water deluge system and remote-operated valves protect it; it is mounded or spaced per fire codes.

foundation: Set on a level foundation designed for operating, hydro-test and wind/seismic loads; grout base plates; anchor bolts per drawing.
alignment: Check verticality (vertical vessels) or level and slope (horizontal); one saddle bolted, the other slotted for thermal expansion.
piping: Excess-flow and remotely operated valves on liquid lines; spacing and fire protection per NFPA 58/API 2510.
commissioning: Hydro/pneumatic test per code; inspect internals before closing; purge and leak test; commission instruments and relief valves.

lubrication: No lubrication — static equipment (lubricate valve stems and manway hinges only).

video_tutorials.title: LPG Storage Bullet — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the LPG Storage Bullet.
An LPG bullet is a horizontal pressure vessel storing liquefied petroleum gas under its own vapour pressure.
It is filled to no more than about 85 % to allow for liquid expansion, and protected by relief valves, water deluge and remote isolation.
Typical applications include LPG bottling plants and depots; refinery and gas-plant storage; industrial fuel storage.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: LPG Storage Bullet — Operation

script.narration: How the LPG Storage Bullet works.
LPG is stored as liquid with vapour above it.
Liquid is drawn from the bottom; vapour line balances pressure.
Relief valves protect against overpressure (e.g. fire).
The deluge ring cools the shell in a fire.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: LPG Storage Bullet — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the LPG Storage Bullet.
Check level and pressure.
Test relief valves and deluge.
Internal inspection and NDT.
Watch for overfill: high level. Common cause: gauge fault.
Watch for BLEVE risk in fire: fire impingement. Common cause: shell overheating above liquid.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
